projects.title: LogPulse — Automated OSS/BSS Log Triage & RCA Platform
projects.subtitle: Sub-second root cause classification and automated Jira RCA ticket generation
projects.desc: Architected and deployed an automated Root Cause Analysis (RCA) triage platform designed to eliminate manual log analysis bottlenecks across complex OSS/BSS order-to-activate (O2A) pipelines and CRM integrations. Engineered a high-throughput Python/FastAPI backend with sub-second Groq LLM inference to parse unstructured logs, extract diagnostic error signatures, and classify failures across a 5-part telecom error taxonomy (OrderEngine task sequencing, DSLAM node provisioning, CRM-OSS state transition blocks, and ISAP/OFM API integration errors). Enforced a self-policing <70% confidence threshold for human review, automated Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) runbook command generation, and built 1-click Jira/ServiceNow ticket formatters backed by 99 automated test fences — reducing incident diagnosis time from ~20 minutes to under 1 second with 95%+ classification accuracy.

projects.title: AI-Assisted Telecom Ticket Intelligence & Escalation Platform
projects.type: Built via Whale Cloud Technology · OSS/BSS · RAG
projects.subtitle: Retrieval-driven evidence for ticket triage,with human override retained
projects.desc: Extended a retrieval pipeline with multi-step reasoning for evidence-grounded resolution recall — chaining retrieved evidence into a structured triage decision rather than only matching similar tickets. Built an eval suite gating LLM output before production use, with guardrails for safety validation on auto-generated RCA/triage decisions and full tracing across the reasoning pipeline. Designed the cross-module dependency-mapping layer, modeling relationships across CRM, OSS, BSS, Billing, DSCM, Mediation,and Network Management to surface downstream failure impact ahead of time, extending the platform into an AI-assisted intelligence layer for telecom incident h andling.

projects.title: Zsmart 9.2 Platform Upgrade — BSNL (Government of India)
projects.subtitle: Live cutover support across BSNL's national telecom subscriber base
projects.desc: Executed live cutover support and production validation for the Zsmart 9.2 upgrade across BSNL's national subscriber base, maintaining system availability and minimizing planned migration window overruns. Secured post-release stabilization by executing targeted MySQL queries to audit backend data consistency, resolving critical migration discrepancies before they impacted active billing cycles. Validated end-to-end business flows across OSS/BSS, CRM,and DSCM modules, tracking defects in JIRA,and managing the operational integration of the Huawei CDOT voice module with zero downtime for existing active directory lines.

caseStudies.title: AI-Driven CRM Support & Diagnostics — FGS (Swisscom)
caseStudies.subtitle: GenAI-assisted incident investigation onto the Swisscom enterprise CRM account
caseStudies.desc: Deployed Claude and Python scripting into CRM incident investigation workflows for the Swisscom account, speeding up log parsing and cutting down manual documentation effort. Applied duplicate-ticket detection via embeddings on the Swisscom CRM/OSS-BSS queue to speed up RCA lookup during daily triage,with output checked against evals/guardrails before use in live ticket workflows. Served on FGS's research team, contributing to agentic workflow design for an early-stage AI-in-a-Box/CX platform rollout.

caseStudies.title: Order-to-Activate Optimization — Whale Cloud
caseStudies.subtitle: Improved O2A throughput across a large-scale subscriber environment
caseStudies.desc: Resolved CRM-to-OSS state-transition blocks, collaborative waiting failures,and masterless order discrepancies through structured incident management, improving end-to-end Order-to-Activate (O2A) throughput and reducing workflow exception queues. Maintained data integrity between CRM and OSS by executing targeted MySQL queries, correcting spatial parameters across affected service instances,and driving cross-vendor bulk migrations of active directory numbers across core telecom platforms.

caseStudies.desc: Re-engineered L1-to-L3 workgroup mapping and ASSIGN_GROUP routing logic (Zendesk, BMC Remedy, accelerating critical fault resolutionwhile preventing unnecessary L3 escalations.
